principle: T4 diagnosis combines curriculum mastery with upper-secondary readiness. AI mastery, assessment performance, suggested TP evidence and teacher judgement remain separate.

evidence_policy.written: reading, writing, grammar, literature and editing evidence may be extracted from marked physical work
evidence_policy.oral: audio/video/teacher observation required for pronunciation, intonation, debate and interactive speaking
evidence_policy.ocr_uncertain: excluded from confirmed diagnosis until verified
evidence_policy.teacher_mark: priority for correctness when visible; root cause still requires item-response analysis

confidence_rules.high: cross-task, cross-date and clearly attributable evidence

backtracking_rule: Before assigning intensive T4 remediation, inspect mapped T3 and earlier prerequisite nodes. Repair only the earliest demonstrably weak prerequisite, then return to the T4 target.
assessment_separation: An SPM-style score is evidence about assessment performance, not a replacement for the curriculum mastery profile.
tp_policy: System may describe evidence consistent with mastery characteristics but official PBD judgement remains teacher-controlled.
